caption:
💥Mediterranean Eggplant Pocket Bake

If you love easy mediterranean meals, and want a healthy weeknight dinner, you’ve got to try this pocket bake - these come out so good, so saucy, so cheesy, and so easy to make. It’s one of those meals that feels a little extra… but is actually super straightforward.

Ingredients:
2-3 medium eggplants, sliced 1/4–1/3 inch thick
Olive oil
Salt

For the filling:
1lb 80/20 ground beef
1/3 yellow onion, finely diced
2 garlic cloves, minced
1/2 tbsp onion powder
1 tbsp granulated garlic
1/2 tbsp sweet paprika
1 tbsp fresh parsley
Salt & pepper
Optional (if not low carb): 1/2 cup uncooked rice

For assembly:
1/2 jar marinara or pasta sauce
Sliced or shredded mozzarella cheese
Chili flakes
Fresh basil
Shredded parmesan

Here’s how I made it:

1️⃣ Preheat oven to 425°F.

2️⃣ Slice 2-3 eggplants into 1/4 to 1/3 inch thick slices. Lay them out on an oven-safe tray without overlapping. Season with salt and drizzle with olive oil. You may need 2 trays.

3️⃣ Roast for 18–20 mins.

4️⃣ While that cooks, make your beef mixture. In a bowl, combine 1lb ground beef with diced onion, the spices above, salt, and pepper. Mix well. If using rice, add 1/2 cup uncooked rice here.

5️⃣ Form the mixture into 6-8 equal patties or balls.

6️⃣ Remove eggplant from the oven and let cool for about 1 min. Take one slice and lay it across your palm, then place another slice across it in an “X” shape.

7️⃣ Add one beef patty in the center, then fold each side over to create a pocket. Repeat for all.

8️⃣ In an oven-safe dish, spread about half a jar of marinara on the bottom. Place the eggplant pockets on top. Cover with a lid. Bake at 425°F for 22–24 mins.

9️⃣ Remove, top with mozzarella and chili flakes, then broil for 2–3 mins until melted and bubbly.

Serve as-is, or top with shredded parmesan, some basil, or pair with a side of rice or @kaizenfoodco high-protein rice to make it low carb and even more filling.

If you make it, be sure to tag me on SHREDHAPPENS!

ENJOY!

transcript: Chances are you probably love Mediterranean food. These eggplant pockets are made right in the oven, so easy and so good. They're also packed with protein and one of the meals that's helped me lose close to 150 pounds. We'll start by thinly slicing some eggplant, lay them out on a sheet pan, season with salt, drizzle with olive oil, and pop it into the oven for a short visit. To stuff these, mix ground beef with onion, salt, pepper, and a few easy spices. Form them into patties, make an X across your palm with two eggplant slices, place the patty inside, fold it up, pop it into the oven over some marinara sauce, then remove, add fresh mozzarella, put it on broil, and enjoy. Full recipes in the caption. Check it out.
title: Mediterranean Eggplant Pocket Bake
one_liner: Roasted eggplant slices folded into pockets around spiced ground beef, baked in marinara and topped with mozzarella.

Low-carb friendly; creator credits the meal as part of losing nearly 150 pounds
